name: dsh-xswt-tauriapp
description: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的轻量 Tauri 桌面外壳：窗口、进程、启动与复用、会话交接、菜单与托盘、快捷键、更新和故障恢复归外壳，页面内容仍归 dsh。 A lightweight Tauri desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: windows, the dsh server process, launch and reuse, the session hand-off, menu and tray, hotkeys, updates and failure recovery are the shell's; the page stays dsh's.
